name: API gateway: inbound p95 more than twice its last hour
Deployment not reporting
message: A deployment that reported in the last hour has sent nothing for five minutes.

query.sql: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS d, max(TimeUnix) AS last FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_build_info' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY d HAVING last < $__fromTime)

name: Scripts: oldest due run over 10 minutes
Background loop silent for a day
message: A background loop has not finished an iteration in 26 hours; the daily sweeps run every 24.

query.sql: SELECT max(dateDiff('second', toDateTime(last), now())) FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS d, Attributes['loop'] AS loop, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS last FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'background_loop_last_success_timestamp' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY d, loop)

query.expr: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 100 * ({a}) / nullIf(({b}), 0) AS v) WHERE v IS NOT NULL

name: Configuration warnings logged
message: The platform logged configuration warnings (at startup or on a persona write); the saved search MCP: configuration warnings lists them.

query.sql: SELECT max(100 * u.used / b.budget) FROM (SELECT deployment, bucket, sum(v) AS used FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['bucket'] AS bucket, Attributes['purpose'] AS purpose, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes, Attributes, cityHash64(Attributes, ResourceAttributes) AS sid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'storage_bucket' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY ResourceAttributes, Attributes, sid) GROUP BY deployment, bucket, purpose) GROUP BY deployment, bucket) AS u INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['bucket'] AS bucket, max(Value) AS budget FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'storage_bucket_budget' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY deployment, bucket) AS b USING (deployment, bucket) WHERE b.budget > 0

name: Bucket reaches its budget within 14 days
message: At the last day's growth a bucket fills its budget within two weeks.

query.sql: SELECT countIf((n.used - d.used) > 0 AND (b.budget - n.used) / (n.used - d.used) < 14) FROM (SELECT deployment, bucket, sum(v) AS used FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['bucket'] AS bucket, Attributes['purpose'] AS purpose, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes, Attributes, cityHash64(Attributes, ResourceAttributes) AS sid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'storage_bucket' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY ResourceAttributes, Attributes, sid) GROUP BY deployment, bucket, purpose) GROUP BY deployment, bucket) AS n INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['bucket'] AS bucket, max(Value) AS budget FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'storage_bucket_budget' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY deployment, bucket) AS b USING (deployment, bucket) INNER JOIN (SELECT deployment, bucket, sum(v) AS used FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['bucket'] AS bucket, Attributes['purpose'] AS purpose, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes, Attributes, cityHash64(Attributes, ResourceAttributes) AS sid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'storage_bucket' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 25 HOUR AND TimeUnix < $__fromTime - INTERVAL 23 HOUR AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY ResourceAttributes, Attributes, sid) GROUP BY deployment, bucket, purpose) GROUP BY deployment, bucket) AS d USING (deployment, bucket)

name: Transaction id age over one billion

Storage writes refused
message: Object writes failed with access_denied, bucket_missing or quota_exceeded: a credential, policy or quota problem, not an outage.

query.sql: SELECT v FROM (SELECT ((SELECT sumOrNull(v) FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, MetricName AS metric, Attributes['purpose'] AS purpose, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes, MetricName, Attributes, cityHash64(Attributes, ResourceAttributes) AS sid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('storage_orphaned_objects', 'storage_dangling_references') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY ResourceAttributes, MetricName, Attributes, sid) GROUP BY deployment, metric, purpose))) - ((SELECT sumOrNull(v) FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, MetricName AS metric, Attributes['purpose'] AS purpose, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes, MetricName, Attributes, cityHash64(Attributes, ResourceAttributes) AS sid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('storage_orphaned_objects', 'storage_dangling_references') AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 25 HOUR AND TimeUnix < $__fromTime - INTERVAL 23 HOUR AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY ResourceAttributes, MetricName, Attributes, sid) GROUP BY deployment, metric, purpose))) AS v) WHERE v IS NOT NULL
